data.name: Manibhushan
data.gender_notes: Manibhushan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mani means 'jewel' and Bhushan means 'ornament' or 'decoration'. Manibhushan refers to one who is the embodiment of wisdom and knowledge. In Hindu mythology, Manibhushan is also a name for Lord Shiva and represents the god of wisdom. The name Manibhushan carries the meaning “Jewel of the mind” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Manibhushan usually hope their child will grow to embody jewel of the mind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Manibhushan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Jewel of the mind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Manibhushan total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: In Hindu mythology, the name Manibhushan is believed to bring good fortune, prosperity, and wisdom. It is also considered an auspicious name for infants, particularly boys.
data.spiritual_significance: Manibhushan represents the divine wisdom and knowledge that one can attain through spiritual practice and enlightenment. It is believed that one who embodies this name is a teacher, a guide, and a source of wisdom for others. In Hinduism, Lord Shiva is known as Manibhushan, the one who bestows the jewel of wisdom.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Manibhushan: Wearer of the Gem of the Mind. Symbolizes the pursuit of wisdom and knowledge, with the gem representing the inner light of the soul.

historical_references.reference: Manibhushan was a famous Jain Tirthankara (religious leader) who lived around 527-487 BCE. He is considered the 24th Tirthankara in the present Jaina cosmic cycle.
Manibhushan is also an epithet for Lord Shiva, the Hindu god of destruction. He is sometimes referred to as Manibhushan or Mani-Bholenath, particularly in Bengal and Orissa.

In modern contexts, this name is seen on various platforms: 1) Social media: It is a popular name among Indian users on social media platforms like Facebook and Twitter. 2) Literature and media: Manibhushan is a name of a character in Indian literature and media. For instance, it is the name of a character in the popular Indian comic book series 'Chandamama'. 3) Weddings and events: Manibhushan is a popular name for Hindu boys and is often used in Hindu naming ceremonies (Namkaran) and weddings. Overall, the name Manibhushan reflects the rich cultural heritage of Hinduism and is a significant part of Indian names and traditions.
